scope: 40 exact historical keys outside other assignments; full old operators, endpoint meanings and stances inspected against source component review. Intervening exact endpoint definitions read where referenced.

rows.review_disposition: 60DA can internalize the emergence of Catholic and royal identity within a locally rooted, multi-causal uprising. Preserve the distinction between initial popular resistance and subsequent noble command.
8A64 must explicitly retain Lindet and the Subsistence Commission administering the Maximum, including purchasing, trade, distribution and detailed schedules on 265.
488D can internalize Danton’s later association with indulgence while retaining September coercion and his defense of compromised associates. Moderation was a phase, not a timeless identity.
BBD must preserve both the misleading federalist label and the serious but exaggerated geographic extent. Neither implies a unified separatist movement.
60DA must preserve army defeat followed by deliberate devastation, distinguish infernal columns from judicial Terror, and retain mortality uncertainty rather than equating all deaths with battles.
E57 can internalize design followed by ratification and nonimplementation. The 246 discussion should not be presented as the whole later suspension mechanism on 252.

7549 can internalize the named southeastern prison massacres, weak or complicit protection and the opportunity created by detaining former terrorists together. Preserve revenge and regional variation, not an exclusively royalist programme.
CC141 can retain the Committee as a component of broader emergency expansion. Preserve its evolving remit and other institutions’ independent roles.

Toulon’s social/economic grievances are substantive, but a broad composite federalist motive cannot be assigned wholesale to the city. Retire the repeated edge with its actual property, sectional and anti-Jacobin coalition explicit.
Lindet’s organization contributed to the controlled economy and temporary assignat recovery. Internalize in 8A64 with administrative mechanism and limits; do not assert a single sufficient cause.

The crisis helped justify emergency government and deferral of constitutional rule. Correct the broad caused_by formulation so that it does not claim war caused every design or ratification choice; preserve 252’s explicit suspension argument.
8A64 can internalize the Maximum’s administration by Lindet’s Commission. Preserve roles and chronology rather than merely listing the person as an alias.
British expedition expectations undermined final submission in the 1795 agreements. 8B56 should retain the correctly directed effect and rebel strategic calculation on 289–290.

Women’s price-setting responded to real provisioning distress. Retain the actual crowd practice and material grievance within 8A64, with women’s access and the distinction from official price regulation.
BBD can internalize mostly republican aims, opportunistic royalist participation and the polemical label. Do not conflate constitutional decentralization with Bourbon restoration.
8B56 can retain Hoche’s conciliation addressing persistent rural insurgency after the army’s defeat. Preserve the reversal from Turreau and loss of republican rural control.
CC141 can internalize surveillance committees responding to spring military and internal danger. Distinguish their creation from subsequent centralization and Law of Suspects operation.
Retire the projected Vendéan-army-as-component-of-government edge. Preserve the army’s terrain, local supply, rapid massing and limits in 60DA and the military emergency as context in CC141.
488D can internalize the Vieux Cordelier publicizing indulgence, with Desmoulins’s critiques and Robespierre’s changing attitude explicit. Named publication access is required.

9446 can internalize virtue as the organizing principle of the Republic of Virtue. Preserve public-over-private interest, political purification and the separate civic-religion route rather than a slogan alone.

Retire the native synthesis-to-federalism taxonomy because CC141 is narrower than the historical crisis umbrella. Keep the mutually reinforcing crises and divided opponents in the broader reader task, with BBD retaining the specific revolt.

Retire the projected crisis-to-Vendée component relation while preserving local causes, early military strength, coordination limits and the crisis’s wider combination. Administrative government is not the parent of every war event.

CC141 can internalize emergency centralization as one response to the combined crisis. Preserve that survival also depended on opponents’ divisions and political resolve rather than a single decisive policy.
48B221 can internalize Fructidor’s arrests, newspaper closures and election annulments. Preserve these as distinct coercive mechanisms and retain military pressure behind legal forms.

3F2B can internalize eviction and closure of the Manège Club in the 1799 backlash. Preserve Jacobin revival, magnified public-order fears and Sieyès’s executive project; do not imply military recovery preceded every suppression measure.

CB77 can internalize the stability aim of Year III checks, rotation and slow amendment. Preserve the conservative republic’s civil commitments and intended exclusion of both royalism and Jacobin Terror.

Correct the reversed old consequence: Police Legion dissolution increased army dependence. Preserve the premature mutiny versus scheduled Equals uprising distinction in 032D and the cumulative dependence in 21A.

Correct supported_by direction: Artois’s assurances encouraged Jalès planning. Retain the actual support in 8885/8EB while distinguishing promises from foreign troops, effective command or military capacity.

Favras is a specific early domestic conspiracy; an extra example edge can retire with 6EA/9EDD retaining the episode and historically emergent scope. Do not invent proven Turin control or unambiguous Bourbon sponsorship.

Correct the reversed election sequence: loss of the stable majority helped produce the executive-legislative crisis. Preserve 0364/47D’s uncertainty and Barthélemy’s replacement of Letourneur, not an already unified royalist takeover.

La Rouërie’s network preceded chouannerie but was not identical with all later guerrilla bands or Puisaye’s claimed army. Retire the broad precursor edge only with chronological connection, provincial/religious basis and unclear operational plan retained in 2CAD/FB2.
Army support in 1797 was tied to military prestige and preservation of conquests. Preserve that motive in 21A/0D88 rather than a generic assertion of republican conviction or personal loyalty.

Correct promoted_by direction: Puisaye promoted Quiberon. Preserve inflated claims of control and the expedition’s separate actors, divided command and operational failure; the event did not promote its planner in that same sense.

5B270 can internalize the Belgian concentration of oath refusers and officials’ fear of provoking resistance. An unresolved general French-rule target is unnecessary, but the practical limit on enforcement is substantive.

A Britain-as-example edge can retire if C479/C4FA retain both material royalist support and British strategic self-interest. Do not present the powers as one restoration alliance or British aid as unconditional.
B888/0364 can retain Blankenburg’s ambiguity and constitutional royalists’ hopes. Do not treat it as clear acceptance of constitutional monarchy or a decisive electoral cause.

29CD/F4D can retain Floréal as a continuation of electoral authoritarianism, with the outgoing Councils’ purge and selection of alternatives explicit. This was a coup against electoral choice, not ordinary scrutiny.

Correct the flattened qualified_by direction and retain heterogeneity among elected royalists and exiles. Do not equate all 182 winners with Pichegru or collapse constitutional monarchists into uncompromising pures.

C455 can internalize Nîmes within southern Catholic royalism, preserving local confessional dynamics, emerging Bourbon organization and defeated Catholics’ later martyr role. Not all southern violence was émigré-directed.

2E013 can internalize Fructidor hardening French peace terms and ending compromise support on 217–218. Preserve British willingness to concede, the Dutch/Spanish colonial demand and maritime leverage; do not make Britain uniformly unwilling to negotiate.
